nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Generate model images by combining a source product image with a model head image, optional masks, scene references, and prompt guidance.

customNegPrompt.description: Negative prompt to avoid unwanted artifacts.

customPrompt.description: Positive generation prompt, up to 600 characters.

genOriRes.description: Whether to generate the original resolution. Defaults to false.

imageSegUrl.description: Optional segmentation mask URL for the source image.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the source product or outfit image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

modelHeadImageUrl.description: Public URL of the target model head image. The image must be up to 5 MB and between 512 and 2048 pixels in both width and height.

modelPrompt.description: Comma-separated model appearance terms, such as smile, laugh, sitting, lying, fat, plump, slim, sideways, profile, back, or bald.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

realModel.description: Whether to prefer a realistic model style.

sceneImgUrl.description: Optional scene reference image URL. The image must be up to 10 MB and between 768 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

sceneStrength.description: Scene reference strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7.

name: nexscope_ai_model_swap
title: AI Model Swap API
